# Proto-Vox
The main reason for Cyberneticization in Vox is, unsurprisingly, to get rid of their nitrogen dependancy first and foremost.
## Racial Features - They breathe nitrogen and most notably, [color=green]oxygen is no longer toxic to them[/color]. - Thanks to their bio-engineered lungs, they can store up to 10L of gas inside of them to breathe. - Their blood is anaerobic and it has an opaque blue tint. - In addition to regular foods, they [color=#1e90ff]can also eat various snack packaging, banana peels, eggshells, and raw meat without any ill effects[/color]. They also like to drink welding fuel. - Their body can [color=#1e90ff]slowly heal poison damage[/color] on its own as long as it does not exceed 25 poison damage. - On top of that, they receive [color=#1fb0ff](10%-30%-40%) slash and piercing damage resistance[/color] depending on their cybernetic choice. (Access your species specific loadout from the Appearance tab) - They have a [color=#1fb0ff]Built in MIDI player[/color] - Due to their mixed mechanical and biological nature, they can [color=#1fb0ff]heal with both chemicals and topicals, and welders and wires[/color], however [color=#ffa500]both methods are only 50% effective[/color]. - They are [color=#ffa500]damaged slightly and immobilised by EMPs[/color]. - They have an in-built [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Radio Channel accessed with the key :D[/color] - Their fists deal [color=red]6[/color] slash damage with unarmed attacks. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they can withstand temperatures between -15 and 50 degrees Celcius.
## Vod-Pidgin and Trinary The Vox language, known as Vod-Pidgin, is composed of shrieks and caws. It is often described as loud and chaotic and it is quite difficult to learn for non Vox as most end up shredding their vocal chords when trying to speak it. Like all other Protogens, they are also able to speak and understand Trinary, a language similar to binary but able to be spoken by most synthetics.
## Age and Names Vox, being an artificial species, are born already adults and can live anywhere from as little as a couple of years to several centuries. Their names are chosen from physical or mental features that best describe them, often being a combination of several words strung together. For those that do not speak Vod-Pidgin, these names sound like strings of sharp syllables, often starting with K, R or T.
